analysis_contract.D_definition: For arm in {raw,corrected}, D(T,S,arm)=[eta_star(T,S,arm)/eta_star(T,S,mu0)]/(1-0.9). The mu0 reference has structural D=1 and is not given a fitted response surface.

eta_star_estimator.curve: loss=a*x^2+b*x+c fitted to the five exact registered eta values using the five-seed mean endpoint loss
eta_star_estimator.unbracketed_rule: nonpositive curvature or boundary/outside vertex is UNBRACKETED; no point may be dropped and no ladder may be extended after outcomes

joint_bootstrap.gate_role: evaluable only if at least 9500 of 10000 joint refits retain all 36 interior eta optima
joint_bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric training-seed bootstrap; one shared five-index resample refits all 36 eta curves, independently repeats the registered eight-cell F1/F2/F3 leave-one-out model selection for both momentum arms, refits each selected surface on all eight training cells, and recomputes all held-out errors

analysis_contract.missing_or_nonfinite_rule: any required missing, invalid, or nonfinite cell makes G6 NOT_EVALUABLE rather than excludable
analysis_contract.primary_outcome: finite fixed-development endpoint NLL per trained token

authority.amendment_rule: this disclosed pre-outcome surface-family amendment supersedes fb78bf9295035ca3189d72f62092aac525467631; after the amended commit is pushed, no outcome-aware amendment, recentering, ladder extension, holdout substitution, candidate-family change, or selection-rule change is allowed
authority.contract_kind: prospective full-factorial code, execution, and held-out analysis contract
launch_manifest_requirements: raw sha256 of both contract files and frozen analyzer
exact materialized input manifests and every referenced input hash
canonical sha256 of every attempt-1 and registered attempt-2 command
PASS gate proof showing v4 48/48 evidence, zero run_slot_v4 processes on both nodes, and a G5 VERDICT line in the v5 note
authority.node_execution_commit: all 900 cells execute at the pushed v6 registration commit on both nodes
authority.prior_records_immutable: v1-v5 and exploratory result trees are read-only to v6

pre_outcome_amendment.changed_scope: replace the single log-T/log-S interaction response family with a prospectively fixed F1/F2/F3 model-selection protocol, independently per momentum arm
pre_outcome_amendment.outcome_blinding_proof: at amendment start there was no v6 result root on either node, no run_slot_v6 process, no immutable v6 gate proof, no v6 launch authority, and no v6 scientific outcome
pre_outcome_amendment.reason: pre-v6 evidence showed approximately linear-in-T corrected drift and the referee rejected the prior additive response-surface rationale as overfit; the amendment protects the four already registered held-out cells without changing any scientific run coordinate
pre_outcome_amendment.referee_F3_resolution: the referee record says CONFIRMED lanes: none, so the directive's fixed fallback F3 is used
pre_outcome_amendment.unchanged_scope: all 900 T,S,H,arm,eta,seed cells; eta centers and ladders; input bytes; held-out and training partitions; success band and 3-of-4 rule; bootstrap count; retry rails; scheduling; storage; fleet gates; and 30-hour ceiling

corrected_mu0.9.interpretation: empirical centering model only. It decomposes the measured corrected drift into commit-horizon and local-window components. The common-rho/equal-displacement mechanism was rejected by the two-parameter audit and is not claimed here.

mu0.center_rule: at target 135M, eta0_center=2^(beta_0+beta_S*log2(S/2560)+beta_H*log2(H/512)); the model-size coordinate is zero
mu0.interpretation: log-linear interpolation/extrapolation in S and H. The separate parameter-scale coefficient lets the v4 1.7B pilot inform scale without treating a 1.7B eta as a 135M target observation.

raw_mu0.9.interpretation: constant-gradient terminal code-true Nesterov multiplier; the wide ladder, not an outcome-aware shift, absorbs observed departures

eta_grid.wide_grid_rationale: three preceding campaigns lost evaluability to boundary/nonconvex fits; all v6 ladders are symmetric, prospectively wide, and immutable

completed_cell_requires: exact registered command hash and clean pushed source commit
immutable attempt id plus start/end records
exact S learner steps for each of four learners
exact 4*T strict-quorum tape rows with every responder c_steps=H and c_tokens=128*H
one valid yeto_rho_telemetry_v1 row per outer commit
finite 1024-row endpoint loss and successful learner/syncer exits
checkpoint, per-example loss, evaluation provenance, result, tape, telemetry, command, git commit, and git diff evidence hashes

frozen_analyzer.freeze_rule: committed and pushed before any v6 scientific process; outcome-aware edits forbidden; identical bytes distributed to both node control planes

gate_G6.failure_rule: complete bracketed evidence with either momentum arm succeeding on fewer than three held-out cells is FAIL
gate_G6.not_evaluable_rule: missing/invalid cell evidence, any of 36 unbracketed optima, a singular required candidate/LOO/refit surface, or fewer than 9500 valid joint bootstrap refits is NOT_EVALUABLE
gate_G6.pass_rule: each of raw and corrected independently has |log2(D_pred)-log2(D_obs)| <= 0.2 on at least 3 of its 4 held-out cells

model_selection.arm_scope: run independently for raw and corrected
model_selection.bootstrap_rule: repeat the complete arm-specific leave-one-out selection and selected-family refit inside every joint paired-seed bootstrap replicate

candidate_families.resolution: fixed fallback because the pre-launch referee confirmed no theory lane

model_selection.heldout_exclusion: the four held-out D outcomes are never read during model selection or the all-eight training refit
model_selection.loo_protocol: for each candidate, leave each of the eight training coordinates out once, fit on the other seven, predict the omitted log2(D), and score root mean squared error over the eight omitted predictions
model_selection.refit_and_predict: select the candidate with minimum LOO RMSE, refit that family on all eight training cells, then predict the four held-out cells
model_selection.tie_break: candidates within 1e-12 bits of the minimum LOO RMSE are tied; choose the first in fixed priority F1, F2, F3

heldout_prediction.structural_reference: mu0 has D=1 by definition and is excluded from the nontrivial response-surface gate

objective: Measure the joint T x S dependence of raw and bias-corrected outer Nesterov at 135M/M=4, prospectively select an arm-specific response family from F1/F2/F3 using only eight training coordinates, and test the selected surfaces on four registered held-out coordinates.

retry_contract.scope: loss-blind whole paired-seed curve group T,S,arm,seed: all five etas retry together under a separately hash-bound authority; no individual eta retry

runner_and_data_feasibility.fixed_window_code_audit: learner and compare_diloco parsers require only positive integer fixed-window microsteps/tokens and impose no upper H cap; command contract sets learner_max_steps=S and syncer_total_steps=4*T
runner_and_data_feasibility.verification: S%T=0, H=S/T, S%H=0, S/H=T for all 12 cells; fixed-window tokens=128*H; each learner has at least 26399 complete blocks and uses at most 10240

storage.volume: the v4-discovered XFS LVM mounted at /data on each node (approximately 27.9 TB total per node)

wall_clock.measurement: launch-authority creation immediately before slot-controller start through final immutable evidence seal, including retries and analysis
wall_clock.on_breach: terminate remaining process groups, retain every attempt, mark unstarted cells NOT_RUN_WALL_CEILING, and report G6 NOT_EVALUABLE; never extend after outcomes
